updates.title: OasisOS — migration underway
updates.body: OasisOS is moving the custom Oasis content onto a modern Old School (rev 240) RuneLite base. Release is close.
updates.author: Oasis

updates.title: Old School RuneLite base
updates.body: Built on a modern Old School foundation with a custom RuneLite client — items, interfaces and settings are being ported across.
updates.author: Oasis

updates.title: Releasing soon
updates.body: Once content migration wraps, OasisOS goes live and its Play button lights up right here in the launcher.
updates.author: Oasis
